CustomField.description: OpenAI API key for the GUS chat proxy, used when Chat_Provider__c is OpenAI. Set in Setup → Custom Settings → GTM Agent Settings → Manage → New (org default). Plain Text (175-char max) -- verified real-world OpenAI "sk-..." / "sk-proj-..." key lengths fit within that ceiling. GTM_Agent_Settings__c is a Hierarchy Custom Setting, which does not support EncryptedText; protection for this value is the Apex-level write-only/never-prefill boundary in GtmAgentSettingsController, matching Claude_API_Key__c's existing shape/precedent.
CustomField.label: OpenAI API Key
